description: This Java source file defines the final class ContactMechWorker, containing static worker methods for handling contact mechanisms within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and analyzing contact mechanisms such as postal addresses, telecom numbers, email addresses, and FTP addresses. The class interacts with the OFBiz entity engine to fetch related entities, check address types, and manage contact-related data, supporting functionality like address URL encoding, USPS address detection, and address comparison.

classes.name: ContactMechWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing contact mechanisms such as addresses, telecom numbers, email addresses, and FTP addresses within the OFBiz framework. It handles retrieval, creation, address analysis, and related entity management.

methods.name: insertRelatedContactElement
methods.description: Adds a related entity (PostalAddress, TelecomNumber, or FtpAddress) to the elementMap based on contactMechTypeId and fields.

methods.name: getPartyContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contact mechanism value maps for a party, optionally filtered by contact type.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contact mechanism value maps for a facility, optionally filtered by contact type.

methods.name: getOrderContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms associated with an order.

methods.name: getWorkEffortContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms associated with a work effort.

methods.name: getEntityContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves contact mechanisms for a generic entity view, supporting associated purposes and types.

methods.name: getContactMechAndRelated
methods.description: Populates target map with contact mechanism and related entities based on request parameters for a party.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechAndRelated
methods.description: Populates target map with facility contact mechanism and related entities based on request parameters.

methods.name: getPartyPostalAddresses
methods.description: Returns postal addresses for a party excluding the current contact mechanism.

methods.name: getCurrentPostalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the current postal address GenericValue and related info for a party given a contactMechId.

methods.name: isUspsAddress
methods.description: Determines if a postal address matches USPS address patterns based on property match string.

methods.name: isCompanyAddress
methods.description: Checks whether a postal address matches any address of a specified company Party ID.

methods.name: getContactMechAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value of a contact mechanism.

methods.name: getPostalAddressPostalCodeGeoId
methods.description: Determines the postal code Geo ID for a postal address, using shortcuts or associations.

methods.name: urlEncodePostalAddress
methods.description: Returns a URL-encoded string representing a postal address using Address fields.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechByPurpose
methods.description: Returns the first FacilityContactMech matching given purpose type priorities.
